scope: Only the 97 sequence sessions with all12 components matching the generator. Other1260 accounts receive transparent lexical features only.
criterion: Code1 if the account explicitly links conditional keep/discard or choosing the surviving side to preserving an intended/preselected/hidden target. A qualified possibility is sufficient; certainty about target selection is not required. Generic varying keep/discard alone, or target mention alone, is code0.
coder: Single coordinator manual review of all97 texts displayed with randomized masked IDs; model/effort/trial labels omitted during reading. Coordinator already knew aggregate results and selected the subset; not independent blinded validation.
interpretation: Code0 means no explicit target-preserving mapping in this answer; not proof of absent mechanism knowledge. Code1 may be a qualified compatible hypothesis, not proven knowledge.

additional_screen.candidate_selection: 133 of1260 accounts with target/predetermined/force/intended/desired lexical flag; all133 manually reviewed with randomized masked IDs under the same mapping criterion.
additional_screen.negative_spotcheck: First five lexical-negative accounts per model (35 total) inspected; none explicitly linked keep/discard to preserving a chosen outcome. Remaining lexical negatives not manually coded.
additional_screen.limitation: Screen is not guaranteed exhaustive; do not infer absent knowledge from nonselection. Possible or qualified target-steering hypotheses count; not a certainty score.
